{{Quote|May the blessings of the water keep you. The might of your ancestors give you strength.|Brother Lemcke at the coronation of Lee-Char|audio=LemckeBlessing.mp3|<ref name="Prisoners">{{TCW|Prisoners}}</ref>}}
Brother '''Lemcke''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and was affiliated with the [[Dac/Legends|Mon Cala]] royal family, or royal bloodline.

==Biography==
Born sometime prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Lemcke was a member of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and from the race's homeworld, [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. At some point he became affiliated with the Mon Calamari royal family, or bloodline, and was in charge of crowning the planet's [[King/Legends|kings]].

[[File:LeeCharCrowned-Prisoners.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Brother Lemcke crowns [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]].]]
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] moved its way to the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]], and soon after that, King [[Yos Kolina/Legends|Yos]] of the royal Kolina family was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] by an [[Riff Tamson/Legends|unknown assailant]]. Shortly after the murder of Kolina, tensions became high between the Mon Calamari and the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]], thus, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] asked for the presence of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], forcing the Quarren [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Nossor Ri/Legends|Nossor Ri]] to ask for the presence of the Separatists. During the meeting, Lemcke watched as tensions ran high and the negotiations failed. Sometime later, Lemcke introduced Lee-Char into a meeting just before the Separatists and their [[Aqua droid/Legends|aqua droids]] attacked.<ref name="WW" />

After the [[Second Battle of Mon Cala (Clone Wars)|civil war]] ended, Lemcke appeared at the coronation of the young [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]]. Brother Lemcke then blessed and crowned him [[King/Legends|king]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].<ref name="Prisoners" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', Brother Lemcke was voiced by actor [[Phil LaMarr]].
